Privacy Policy

How personal data from the site and from enquiries is handled.

AWAITING TEXT

What the document must contain. The document must set out what personal data the site and the enquiry form collect, the lawful basis for holding it, how long it is kept, which processors it is shared with, any transfer outside Malaysia, and the route for a person to request access, correction or deletion.

A Privacy Policy link already exists in the footer of the current live site. The text behind it was never captured and does not appear in any supplied document.

DRAFT WORDING FOR IAQ'S APPROVAL, NOT YET A PUBLISHED POLICY
Format: a page on this site, plus a signed PDF where the policy is a controlled document.
Version control: issue date and revision number printed on the document and shown on this page.
Owner: named on publication, so an auditor knows who to ask.
Privacy Policy

This slot carries the published document. It is reserved for the approved wording exactly as IAQ issues it, so a client, an auditor or a regulator reads the authoritative text in full.
